descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a strong analytical and inventive thinker? Do you enjoy developing pitch ideas for stakeholders, clients and investors?

We’re looking for an Investment Banking Analyst to:

• develop pitch book presentations to explain industry trends, discuss client options and recommend strategies to meet client goals
• generate new ideas and creative approaches that push the business forward
• identify and meet client needs, coordinating and working alongside colleagues and investors
• create and analyze financial models for financing transactions
• assess and analyze credit risk as the 1st line of defense
• prepare materials and present recommendations to credit committee
• assist in syndicating underwritten financing to investors, which requires deep understanding of credit risk
• manage and support the development of junior investment bankers
